order_wins: **Highway Infrastructure** — receives a **UPEIDA letter of award for user-fee collection and toll-plaza operation on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway, Rs 220.66 crore over two years**, with patrol vehicles _(~70.6% of mcap)_.

**BMW Ventures** — wins **two purchase orders worth Rs 72.94 crore including taxes from Tata Projects** for TMT steel for a 3x800 MW Adani thermal project, on full advance, within eight weeks _(~16.3% of mcap)_.

**Suratwwala Business Group** — subsidiary Suratwwala Natural Energy Resource gets a **Rs 69 crore (ex-GST) letter of intent from Shree Tatyasaheb Kore Warana SSK** for a 20 MW AC / 28.1 MW DC solar plant _(~18.6% of mcap)_.

**Bikewo Green Tech** — wins **two long-term contract orders from Reliance Industries' Bio Energy Division, Rs 27.15 crore for electric tractors and equipment and Rs 39.31 crore for drivers and operations**, to July 2033; values are estimated and non-binding _(~48.4% of mcap)_.

**Mason Infratech** — takes **three orders from Lodha Group's Cowtown Infotech: Rs 12.90 crore for Palava Waterfront tower core and shell, and Rs 7.01 crore and Rs 3.60 crore at Taloja**, all including taxes _(Rs 23.51 cr, our sum; ~8.9% of mcap)_.

**Praveg** — receives a **Rs 12.99 crore (plus GST) letter of acceptance from Tourism Corporation of Gujarat** to build and run rest shelters for the parade contingent at the Statue of Unity, 20 October to 1 November _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**Happy Square Outsourcing Services** — receives a **two-year work order of about Rs 75.96 lakh including taxes from Madhya Pradesh Power Generating Company**, from 1 October _(~1.6% of mcap)_.

**Krsnaa Diagnostics** — signs a **15-year PPP concession with Punjab Health Systems Corporation to set up and run PET-CT facilities at four government hospitals**; consideration depends on volumes and is not stated.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Neogen Chemicals** — **closes its QIP and prices 26,60,753 shares at Rs 2,255 each** for qualified institutional buyers, about Rs 600 crore by our arithmetic; allotment is to follow _(~9.5% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Venus Pipes & Tubes** — board approves a **preferential issue of up to 22,27,544 shares at Rs 1,670 to 18 investors, up to Rs 372 crore**, with shareholders voting at an 8 October EGM _(~9.3% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Granules India** — allots **2,49,82,906 shares at Rs 585 to four promoter-group holders on converting February 2026 warrants**, total consideration Rs 1,461.50 crore; Chigurupati Uma Devi rises to 12.51%.

**Pro Clb Global** — allots **1,09,20,255 fresh convertible warrants at Rs 31.96 to non-promoter investors** on 25% upfront; full exercise would be about Rs 34.90 crore _(our arithmetic; ~16% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**Fredun Pharmaceuticals** — allots **2,71,200 shares to non-promoter holders including Alchemy Capital on converting 90,400 December-2025 warrants** priced at Rs 1,250; 37,600 warrants remain.

**Vardhman Polytex** — allots **55,25,000 shares at Rs 12.55 to promoter-group Oswal Holding on conversion of warrants issued in March 2025**, on Rs 5.20 crore of 75% balance money; 37,50,000 warrants remain _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**GP Eco Solutions India** — allots **1,20,000 shares to three promoters on converting June-2025 warrants at Rs 348**, receiving Rs 3.13 crore of balance money.
**Shah Metacorp** — allots the **balance 65,00,000 shares at Rs 4.71 to promoter-director Mona Viral Shah on converting June-2025 warrants**, receiving Rs 2.30 crore of balance money.
m_and_a: **Juniper Hotels** — board approves **buying Novotel Imagicaa, a 287-room hotel on about 11 acres at Khopoli, from Imagicaaworld Entertainment for a lump sum of Rs 248 crore**, with definitive documents to follow _(~5.2% of mcap)_.
**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** — board approves **selling Hotel Novotel Imagicaa to Juniper Hotels as a going concern on a slump-sale basis for Rs 248 crore**, subject to shareholder approval.
**PB Fintech** — gives **in-principle approval to buy the remaining 20% of subsidiary MyLoancare Ventures**, price to follow a valuation as of 30 September, and up to Rs 10 crore for PB Wheels.
**LT Foods** — agrees to **buy joint-venture partner Kameda Seika's 49% of Kameda LT Foods (India) for Rs 1.12 crore**, making the rice-snack maker wholly owned by 31 December.

**Primo Chemicals** — **completes the purchase of the remaining 51% of Flow Tech Chemicals** under a second supplementary share purchase agreement, making it a wholly owned subsidiary; consideration not stated in this filing.
**NHC Foods** — board approves **acquiring up to 88% of Lotmor Brands and up to 80% of Walya's Beverages**, for cash or its own shares at Rs 6.50, after due diligence; total price not disclosed.

**Kalpataru Projects International** — Sweden's regulator approves the IPO prospectus of 96.12%-held Linjemontage, in which its Swedish unit **offers up to 15,466,413 shares, about 30.19%, at SEK 46 each**.

**Empower India** — accepts a **non-binding term sheet from Mark AB Capital to acquire all of Valiance Engineers through a share-swap preferential issue**; no value is set and due diligence is pending.
**DUDIGITAL Global** — wholly owned Dudigital Global LLC agrees to **buy 51% of DG AG Holdings, Abu Dhabi, for USD 5,100**, a vehicle for consular, passport and visa services.
**Prabhatam Infra Venture** — board approves **joining Swastik Agro Fresh LLP, a real-estate developer, as a 63.24% partner with a Rs 3.16 crore capital contribution**.

**Park Medi World** — wholly owned Aggarwal Hospital and Research Services signs a **28-year agreement to run the 300-bed Axis Hospital and Research Centre in Kanpur**, paying Axis Educational Society 6% of collections with a Rs 20 lakh monthly minimum.

**GPT Infraprojects** — the NCLT Kolkata orders **shareholder and creditor meetings on merging wholly owned Alcon Builders and Engineers and Jogbani Highway into the company**, within 90 days of its 15 September order.
**Alivus Life Sciences** — incorporates **wholly owned Alivus Life Sciences Do Brasil in São Paulo** for pharmaceuticals, with capital of up to R$500,000.
capex_core: **Rainbow Children's Medicare** — **starts operations at its 50-bed women's and children's hospital in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh**, announced on 29 July.

**ACME Solar Holdings** — subsidiary ACME Renewtech **commissions 66.68 MW of solar and 300 MWh of battery storage in Bikaner, Rajasthan**, Phase I of its first hybrid project, whose solar leg totals 300 MW.

**RIR Power Electronics** — **completes installation of silicon-carbide epitaxial wafer reactors at its Bhubaneswar plant**, part of a planned Rs 618 crore SiC programme; commercial production awaits remaining regulatory formalities.

**Lord's Mark Industries** — completes **Phase I of its Silvassa expansion about three months ahead of its December 2026 target**, taking its surgical and orthopaedic range from 36 to 54 SKUs, with commercial operations from 11 October.
**Fine Organic Industries** — invests **Rs 55 crore in preference shares of wholly owned Fine Organic Industries (SEZ)** to fund its manufacturing unit; the subsidiary has not yet started operations.
**Kinetic Engineering** — subscribes **Rs 10 crore to shares of electric two-wheeler subsidiary Kinetic Watts and Volts**, lifting its holding from 84.69% to 86.15%.
**Infosys** — opens a **new 330,000 sq ft software development block at its Indore campus**, which has more than 3,300 employees.
business_updates: **Fortis Healthcare** — wholly owned Fortis Hospotel signs a **29-year agreement to provide healthcare services at SLJ Society's planned 400+ bed Ashok Vihar, Delhi hospital**, and will lend the society construction funds; amounts not disclosed.

**Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders** — signs an **MoU to be anchor shipyard of a proposed greenfield shipbuilding cluster at Dighi, Maharashtra**, planned for at least 1.2 million gross tonnes a year; no value stated.

**Apollo Micro Systems** — is **awarded transfer of technology for a semi-active laser homing system** and hands over its Vighana multi-influence ground mine, now entering production; no value disclosed.

**One Mobikwik Systems** — says NPCI will allow a **merchant discount rate of up to 0.4% on UPI person-to-merchant payments above Rs 2,000 from 15 October**, previously free transactions it expects to earn on as app provider and acquirer.

**Praj Industries** — signs a **development and commercialisation agreement with Gevo (Nasdaq) giving it exclusive rights to deploy Bio-Isobutanol technology in India**, aimed chiefly at diesel blending; value not disclosed.

**Exide Industries** — signs a **long-term strategic cooperation agreement with Germany's ExCom Energy Solutions** to sell industrial traction and stationary batteries across the European Economic Area under the ExCom brand; value not disclosed.

**Justo Realfintech** — announces **new sales mandates it sizes at about Rs 166 crore: a Rs 70 crore Nashik residential project and Rs 96 crore of Pune commercial business** via Chestertons India; its own fee is not stated.
**Royal Orchid Hotels** — subsidiary Regenta Hotels **opens Regenta Magnus in Viman Nagar, Pune, with 66 rooms**, and 39 more due by December.
distress_risk: **Zee Learn** — Assets Care & Reconstruction Enterprise **invokes its corporate guarantee and calls on it to pay Rs 818.23 crore**; the company says it is evaluating its steps _(~354% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**G R Infraprojects** — **issues a notice terminating, with immediate effect, its April 2026 EPC contracts with NTPC** for battery-storage work at the Mouda Super Thermal Power Station.

**OnMobile Global** — a former consultant alleges **potential anomalies in its operations**; the audit committee has appointed an independent law firm to investigate, and no conclusions have been reached.
**Swastik Pipe** — **settles its Hero FinCorp loan under a one-time settlement** and receives a no-dues certificate, while pursuing settlement or restructuring with its remaining lenders.

**H.G. Infra Engineering** — receives a **Karnataka GST show-cause notice alleging Rs 94 crore of liability for FY2022-23** over input tax credit and turnover reconciliation; it calls the amounts unsustainable.

**Samvardhana Motherson** — Indonesia's tax office **penalises indirect subsidiary PT Atsumitec Indonesia IDR 14.94 billion (INR 81.25 million, per the filing)** after disallowing royalty and SAP licence expenses; no material impact expected.
**Pharmaids Pharmaceuticals** — files **cheque-bounce complaints against Anugraha Chemicals and its partners over Rs 2.63 crore** owed to it under a 2025 disinvestment agreement.
**Virat Crane Industries** — the **Supreme Court directs it to pay Rs 85.12 lakh of market fee** to Andhra Pradesh's Agricultural Marketing Department for 2004–2009.
**The Ugar Sugar Works** — the **High Court sets aside the Karnataka pollution board's closure order** on its Ugar Khurd plant, allowing a fresh inspection; the plant stays operational.
**Fortis Healthcare** — files a **Special Leave Petition in the Supreme Court against the Delhi High Court's 31 August order** in the Daiichi Sankyo v. Malvinder Mohan Singh execution proceedings.
**Seamec** — vessel **SEAMEC Agastya goes off hire for a technical reason from 15 September**, until the defect is fixed.
credit_rating_changes: **Apollo Pipes** — CRISIL **upgrades its bank facilities to Crisil AA-/Stable and A1+ from Crisil A and A1**, removing the positive watch and citing support from the Sudesh Gupta group.
**Juniper Green Energy** — ICRA **upgrades it to [ICRA]AA- (Stable)/A1+ from A+ (Positive)/A1**, citing higher operating capacity and a stronger capital structure after its Rs 1,800 crore IPO.
**R R Kabel** — India Ratings **upgrades its long-term bank facilities to IND AA/Stable from IND AA-/Stable**, affirming IND A1+.
**Aster DM Quality Care** — ICRA **upgrades material subsidiary KIMS Healthcare Management to [ICRA]AA (Stable) from AA-**, citing a stronger parent after the Quality Care India merger.
**Ceinsys Tech** — CARE **upgrades its bank facilities to CARE BBB+/Stable and A3+ from BBB/Positive and A3**, citing a 59% rise in FY26 income to Rs 662.73 crore.
**Durlax Top Surface** — Acuité **upgrades it to ACUITE BBB/Stable and A3+ from BBB- and A3** on Rs 50 crore of bank facilities, citing revenue growth and equity infusion.
**Orient Green Power** — CRISIL **upgrades material subsidiary Beta Wind Farm to CRISIL BBB/Stable from BBB-/Positive**, citing better generation and cash accruals.
**Welspun Living** — India Ratings **upgrades material subsidiary Welspun Global Brands' bank loan facilities to IND AA+/Stable/IND A1+**.
